items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Pops Foster is mentioned by the interviewee only as a source of anecdotes ('Pops Foster told that very dumb story...') and as a musician who worked with Baby Dodds ('He worked with, uh, Johnny St. Cyr and Pops Foster'). The interviewee does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship

ctx.x: But, uh, it was, uh, the main idea was, uh, recorded it, but the main idea was to, uh, transcribe the talking and make a little booklet out of it with quite a few illustrations. It wasn't, uh, any, in any sense a drum method or anything, but he did, uh, talk about the, how the drums should fit into the New Orleans band and the right style to play. Mm-hmm.
